headlines.event_summary_en: China's trade surplus reached $1.04 trillion in the first 10 months of 2026, marking a historic scale. This growth is primarily driven by surging demand for AI-related tech exports, effectively offsetting the downturn pressure from weak domestic consumption.

[Root Cause & Mechanism] AI-driven tech exports offset weak domestic demand
[Perspective & Impact] Hedging against weak domestic demand.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 一边是国内消费者的钱包捂得紧，一边是AI服务器和算力配件在海外卖疯了。只要AI卖得够快，经济周期的眼泪就追不上我，这波是靠算力外交硬生生把顺差拉出了天际线。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Domestic wallets are tightening, but AI hardware is flying off the shelves globally. As long as the AI export machine keeps humming, you can outrun any cyclical downturn with pure, unadulterated compute power.

titans.quote_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
